parameters.label: Broker view
parameters.description: Select the broker workspace whose instruments, market data, account and execution routes will be used. Account selection does not move another broker’s positions.

parameters.label: Market
parameters.description: Restrict instrument search and session/product rules to the selected exchange segment.

parameters.label: Holding
parameters.description: Choose intraday cash or delivery (CNC). Delivery does not permit a new bearish short entry; broker sell authorization may be required.

parameters.label: Holding
parameters.description: Intraday follows the selected MCX contract session cutoff. Carry Forward uses the supported overnight MARGIN route and expiry controls.

parameters.label: Use FYERS history for Motilal
parameters.description: Explicitly permit the selected FYERS account to supply labelled history for Motilal analysis. Execution remains on the selected Motilal account.

parameters.label: FYERS history account
parameters.description: Choose the history-only FYERS account. Its identifiers must never be used to submit Motilal orders.

parameters.label: Underlying search
parameters.description: Find instruments using the selected broker’s current master. Search text alone is not a selected contract.

parameters.label: Instrument
parameters.description: Exact selected underlying. Signals use this underlying; the execution route determines whether orders use options, futures or shares.

parameters.label: Execution mode
parameters.description: Paper simulates fills. Live can submit real broker orders when you explicitly Start. Changing this selector does not change an already running job.

parameters.label: Runner timeframe
parameters.description: Candle interval used for the next runner Start. For example, 5 minutes evaluates five-minute host candles. It stays synchronized with the chart timeframe; an active runner retains its Start settings.

parameters.label: Lots
parameters.description: Position size for the next Start. Indian derivatives use whole lots; Delta uses whole contracts; cash equities use whole shares.

parameters.label: Virtual Paper capital · INR
parameters.description: Virtual INR capital available to Paper execution. This does not add funds to a broker account.

parameters.label: Trade limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of new entry trades allowed for this runner run. Exits and protective position management remain separate.

parameters.label: Configuration name
parameters.description: Name of the single saved configuration for this instrument. Save settings updates that record; renaming does not create a duplicate.

parameters.label: Selected instruments
parameters.description: Instruments selected for independent runner submissions. Differences from each saved configuration are resolved before batch submissions start.

parameters.label: Intrabar entries and EMA exits
parameters.description: OFF evaluates completed candles. ON allows fresh provisional live entry and EMA-exit evaluation; provisional signals can change before candle close.

parameters.label: Sideways filter · quick after-cost loss
parameters.description: After a quick loss, blocks new entries inside the recorded position high–low range until a fresh strict breakout. The window uses host candles touched by the actual trade; incomplete exposure evidence stays locked for review.

parameters.label: Quick-loss window · host candles touched
parameters.description: Maximum host candle intervals touched between the actual entry and exit fills for a quick-loss lock. Both entry and exit candles count. With a limit of 3 on five-minute candles, a losing trade spanning at most three candle intervals can lock new entries until a fresh price breaks its recorded position range. This is not a forced exit after three candles.

parameters.label: Enable Renko Supertrend strategy rules
parameters.description: Master switch for this indicator family. OFF disables its strategy/chart controls while retaining subordinate choices for ON. A running job keeps its captured Start settings.

parameters.label: Allow continuation entries
parameters.description: Optional continuation entries require the supported runtime and selected higher-timeframe agreement. A disabled control means that runtime capability is unavailable; it does not imply the rule is active.

parameters.label: Trading session hours
parameters.description: Read-only broker contract session duration used by reference sizing. Crypto and exchange sessions differ; missing verified policy is shown explicitly.

parameters.label: Renko Supertrend · Strategy
parameters.description: Include Renko Supertrend direction in strategy entry evaluation when its family master is enabled.

parameters.label: Renko Supertrend · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Include Renko Supertrend direction in strategy entry evaluation when its family master is enabled. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: ATR length
parameters.description: Number of candles used for the ATR calculation. In manual reference sizing this also selects the reference ATR period.

parameters.label: Base factor
parameters.description: Multiplier applied by the Supertrend calculation. Changes apply to the next Start.

parameters.label: Brick size mode
parameters.description: Auto derives brick size from the strategy calculation. Manual uses the verified fixed reference brick shown below.

parameters.label: Manual brick size
parameters.description: Fixed reference brick size, retained across live ticks and chart timeframes. Recalculate reference brick explicitly to refresh it.

parameters.label: Higher timeframe check · Strategy
parameters.description: Requires agreement with the selected higher timeframe for new strategy entries when enabled. OFF removes that entry check.

parameters.label: Higher timeframe check · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Requires agreement with the selected higher timeframe for new strategy entries when enabled. OFF removes that entry check. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: Supertrend timeframe (HTF)
parameters.description: Higher candle interval used by the optional higher-timeframe Supertrend check or chart study.

parameters.label: Enable EMA strategy rules
parameters.description: Master switch for this indicator family. OFF disables its strategy/chart controls while retaining subordinate choices for ON. A running job keeps its captured Start settings.

parameters.label: EMA 10 · first EMA · Strategy
parameters.description: Require the first EMA entry criterion when EMA strategy rules are enabled.

parameters.label: EMA 10 · first EMA · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Require the first EMA entry criterion when EMA strategy rules are enabled. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: First EMA period
parameters.description: Number of host candles in the first exponential moving average.

parameters.label: EMA 30 · second EMA · Strategy
parameters.description: Require the second EMA entry criterion when EMA strategy rules are enabled.

parameters.label: EMA 30 · second EMA · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Require the second EMA entry criterion when EMA strategy rules are enabled. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: Second EMA period
parameters.description: Number of host candles in the second exponential moving average.

parameters.label: EMA gap widening · Strategy
parameters.description: Require the signed EMA gap to widen across the configured window before a normal entry.

parameters.label: EMA gap widening · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Require the signed EMA gap to widen across the configured window before a normal entry. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: EMA gap widening window
parameters.description: Number of recent host candles inspected by the EMA gap-widening criterion.

parameters.label: EMA proximity · first EMA · Strategy
parameters.description: Entry-only filter that rejects a price too far from the first EMA. It does not close a held position.

parameters.label: EMA proximity · first EMA · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Entry-only filter that rejects a price too far from the first EMA. It does not close a held position. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: EMA10 distance basis
parameters.description: Measure absolute distance from the first EMA as native price points or as a multiple of completed host ATR.

parameters.label: Entry distance limit · |price − EMA10| / completed ATR, or points
parameters.description: Maximum allowed absolute price-to-first-EMA distance in the selected basis. This limits new entries only.

parameters.label: EMA10 retest entries · Strategy
parameters.description: Optional first-EMA pullback touch and confirmed bounce entry path. Other selected entry gates still apply.

parameters.label: EMA10 retest entries · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Optional first-EMA pullback touch and confirmed bounce entry path. Other selected entry gates still apply. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: Retest: bullish / bearish engulfing
parameters.description: Allow the bullish or bearish engulfing geometry as a retest confirmation.

parameters.label: Retest: bullish / bearish harami
parameters.description: Allow the bullish or bearish harami geometry as a retest confirmation.

parameters.label: Retest: morning / evening star
parameters.description: Allow the intraday morning/evening-star retest geometry; a market-opening gap is not required.

parameters.label: Enable RSI strategy rules
parameters.description: Master switch for this indicator family. OFF disables its strategy/chart controls while retaining subordinate choices for ON. A running job keeps its captured Start settings.

parameters.label: RSI level entry filter · Strategy
parameters.description: Require the configured directional RSI level or inclusive RSI range for new entries.

parameters.label: RSI level entry filter · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Require the configured directional RSI level or inclusive RSI range for new entries. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: RSI entry mode
parameters.description: Choose a single bullish/bearish threshold or an inclusive allowed RSI range.

parameters.label: Bullish RSI minimum
parameters.description: Lower inclusive RSI bound for bullish entries in Between mode.

parameters.label: Bullish RSI maximum
parameters.description: Upper inclusive RSI bound for bullish entries in Between mode.

parameters.label: Bearish RSI minimum
parameters.description: Lower inclusive RSI bound for bearish entries in Between mode.

parameters.label: Bearish RSI maximum
parameters.description: Upper inclusive RSI bound for bearish entries in Between mode.

parameters.label: Bullish RSI strictly above
parameters.description: Strict bullish RSI threshold in Threshold mode; equality does not pass.

parameters.label: Bearish RSI strictly below
parameters.description: Strict bearish RSI threshold in Threshold mode; equality does not pass.

parameters.label: RSI slope filter · Strategy
parameters.description: Require rising RSI for bullish entries and falling RSI for bearish entries. Flat or unready RSI does not satisfy slope.

parameters.label: RSI slope filter · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Require rising RSI for bullish entries and falling RSI for bearish entries. Flat or unready RSI does not satisfy slope. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: RSI period
parameters.description: Number of host candles used to calculate RSI.

parameters.label: Enable ADX strategy rules
parameters.description: Master switch for this indicator family. OFF disables its strategy/chart controls while retaining subordinate choices for ON. A running job keeps its captured Start settings.

parameters.label: Choppy filter · Strategy
parameters.description: Enable the ADX strength/choppiness entry gate; compare ADX with the configured threshold.

parameters.label: Choppy filter · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Enable the ADX strength/choppiness entry gate; compare ADX with the configured threshold. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: ADX threshold
parameters.description: Minimum ADX value required when the ADX strategy filter is enabled.

parameters.label: ADX DI length
parameters.description: Period used to calculate directional movement for ADX.

parameters.label: ADX smoothing
parameters.description: Smoothing period used by the ADX calculation.

parameters.label: Enable Market structure strategy rules
parameters.description: Master switch for this indicator family. OFF disables its strategy/chart controls while retaining subordinate choices for ON. A running job keeps its captured Start settings.

parameters.label: Directional swing structure entry filter · selected host timeframe · Strategy
parameters.description: Require confirmed directional swing structure on the selected host timeframe for normal entries.

parameters.label: Directional swing structure entry filter · selected host timeframe · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Require confirmed directional swing structure on the selected host timeframe for normal entries. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: Enable Supply / demand zones strategy rules
parameters.description: Master switch for this indicator family. OFF disables its strategy/chart controls while retaining subordinate choices for ON. A running job keeps its captured Start settings.

parameters.label: Enable
parameters.description: Enable the manual price-marker and consecutive-completed-close entry filter. This does not submit an immediate manual order.

parameters.label: Bullish marker
parameters.description: Underlying price marker used by the bullish manual-trend completed-close test.

parameters.label: Bearish marker
parameters.description: Underlying price marker used by the bearish manual-trend completed-close test.

parameters.label: Consecutive completed closes
parameters.description: Number of consecutive completed host closes required by the enabled manual price-marker filter.

parameters.label: Volume · chart only
parameters.description: Show broker volume on the chart. Missing volume is not inferred, and this visual switch does not enable strategy entries.

parameters.label: RSI moving average · chart only
parameters.description: Show the moving average of RSI in the chart study. It is independent of strategy entry selection.

parameters.label: Enable ema exits
parameters.description: Enable or disable this exit section as a whole. Child selections are retained for re-enabling. Changes apply to the next Start, not silently to the active run.

parameters.label: EMA breach · configurable exit period · Strategy
parameters.description: Allow an adverse breach of the configurable exit EMA to close an owned position. Completed/intrabar timing follows the selected timing rule.

parameters.label: EMA breach · configurable exit period · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Allow an adverse breach of the configurable exit EMA to close an owned position. Completed/intrabar timing follows the selected timing rule. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: Exit EMA period · host candle close
parameters.description: Period of the EMA used by the enabled EMA breach exit.

parameters.label: Second EMA breach · Strategy
parameters.description: Allow an adverse second-EMA breach as an independent exit criterion.

parameters.label: Second EMA breach · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Allow an adverse second-EMA breach as an independent exit criterion. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: EMA gap contraction · Strategy
parameters.description: Allow EMA-gap contraction to close a position when the associated exit family is enabled.

parameters.label: Enable supertrend exit

parameters.label: Supertrend reversal · Strategy
parameters.description: Allow a confirmed Supertrend reversal to close the owned position when its exit family is enabled.

parameters.label: Supertrend reversal · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Allow a confirmed Supertrend reversal to close the owned position when its exit family is enabled. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: Enable rsi exit
parameters.description: Enable or disable this exit section as a whole. Child selections are retained for re-enabling. Changes apply to the next Start, not silently to the active run.

parameters.label: RSI slope against the position · Strategy
parameters.description: Allow RSI slope against the held direction to trigger an independent exit.

parameters.label: RSI slope against the position · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Allow RSI slope against the held direction to trigger an independent exit. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: Enable adx exit
parameters.description: Enable or disable this exit section as a whole. Child selections are retained for re-enabling. Changes apply to the next Start, not silently to the active run.

parameters.label: ADX below the selected threshold · Strategy
parameters.description: Allow ADX below the configured threshold to trigger an independent exit.

parameters.label: ADX below the selected threshold · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Allow ADX below the configured threshold to trigger an independent exit. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.description: Enable or disable this exit section as a whole. Child selections are retained for re-enabling. Changes apply to the next Start, not silently to the active run.

parameters.label: Opposing confirmed swing structure · Indicator

parameters.label: Enable supply / demand targets

parameters.label: Opposing strong 5m supply/demand target exit · optional · Strategy
parameters.description: Optional exit at an opposing strong five-minute supply/demand zone. Zones and target eligibility depend on verified data.

parameters.label: Opposing strong 5m supply/demand target exit · optional · Indicator
parameters.description: Chart-only selection: Optional exit at an opposing strong five-minute supply/demand zone. Zones and target eligibility depend on verified data. This controls the study/replay display and does not enable the corresponding strategy rule.

parameters.label: Quoted premium cap
parameters.description: Optional quoted option-premium cap for entry selection. It is not an underlying stop or a total-account capital amount.

parameters.label: Daily loss budget
parameters.description: Optional strategy loss-budget limit in the displayed native currency. Blank disables this optional limit; broker affordability checks still apply.

parameters.label: Additional slippage · option premium points per side
parameters.description: Additional cost allowance in option-premium points per side. Actual fill slippage is already reflected in fill prices; an allowance is not a guaranteed fill adjustment.

parameters.label: Enable trailing stop-loss
parameters.description: Enable application-managed trailing exits using fresh observations after entry. This does not place an exchange-resting protective stop by itself.

parameters.label: Trailing stop basis
parameters.description: Choose percentage or underlying-point distance for the full-position trailing policy.

parameters.label: Trailing distance · percent or underlying points
parameters.description: Distance used by the enabled trailing exit in the selected trailing basis.

parameters.label: Hard target · underlying price
parameters.description: Optional absolute underlying target PRICE, not a number of points gained and not an option-premium target. Direction and tick validation apply.

parameters.label: Hard stop-loss · underlying price
parameters.description: Optional absolute underlying stop PRICE, not a loss distance, percentage or option premium. Direction and tick validation apply.

parameters.label: Trade product
parameters.description: Choose bought ATM options or supported perpetual futures. Options buy a Call/Put; futures use the supported long/short contract route.

parameters.label: Optional daily strategy cutoff · IST
parameters.description: Optional crypto daily strategy cutoff in IST. Continuous mode has no daily cutoff; held contract expiry and risk rules still apply.

parameters.label: Price source
parameters.description: Broker price/candle source used for the selected Delta signal instrument. Do not mix another broker’s prices into execution evidence.

parameters.label: Order terms
parameters.description: Supported broker order execution terms. An IOC can fill partly and cancel the remainder; acceptance is not a completed fill.

parameters.label: Crypto trading schedule
parameters.description: Continuous crypto trading runs across days. A daily cutoff is an explicit optional strategy policy; it does not mean crypto has an exchange close.

parameters.label: Chart view
parameters.description: Host view displays broker OHLC. Synthetic view displays calculated Renko bodies. Historical chart signals remain simulations.

parameters.label: History review range
parameters.description: Historical display/replay range. Changing the replay anchor can change path-dependent indicators; it does not rewrite an active runner’s captured settings.

parameters.label: From · IST
parameters.description: Beginning of the custom historical chart range, interpreted in IST.

parameters.label: To · IST
parameters.description: End of the custom historical chart range, interpreted in IST.

parameters.label: Show one-minute Supertrend label
parameters.description: Show or hide the one-minute Supertrend chart label. Chart display only.

parameters.label: Show five-minute Supertrend label
parameters.description: Show or hide the five-minute Supertrend chart label. Chart display only.

parameters.label: Chart & runner timeframe
parameters.description: Authoritative chart and next-Start host candle interval. The Runner timeframe selector mirrors this same value.

parameters.label: Override entry direction
parameters.description: Explicit direction for a separate override-entry action. Requires the active matching runner, fresh evidence, available quota and no conflicting exposure.

parameters.label: SMA of RSI period
parameters.description: Number of usable RSI observations averaged by the chart-only SMA of RSI.

parameters.label: Re-entry after adopted exit
parameters.description: After an adopted existing position exits, allow later qualifying strategy entries. OFF completes management after that position closes.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.description: Filter displayed journal records by Paper or Live. Filtering does not delete trades or change execution mode.

parameters.label: Manual brick reference
parameters.description: Reference sizing value retained by the manual-brick workflow; the displayed verified calculation and selected contract policy govern its use.

parameters.label: Filter
parameters.description: Limit the displayed sector rows to the chosen rank, rotation, alignment or relative-strength category. This is a view filter, not an entry order.
parameters.group: Sector analysis, handoff, screener and planning

parameters.label: Sort by
parameters.description: Choose the metric used to order sector rows. A ranking is analysis rather than a confirmed trade signal.

parameters.label: Sector analysis refresh interval
parameters.description: How often sector analysis is refreshed. A new response is not necessarily a new completed market candle.

sections.title: Start here · accounts and dashboard navigation
text: Choose a saved broker account before reviewing instruments, holdings, funds or orders. FYERS, Dhan, Motilal Oswal and Delta India have separate data and execution routes. Connection status, market-data permission, runner status and order-stream status are different checks.

Configuration → Brokers manages saved connections and account dashboards. User Master manages users and section access for administrators. Sidebar visibility preferences and permissions determine which sections you can open; a hidden section is not proof that its server job stopped.

Use the search box in this guide to find a setting by its on-screen name, strategy or purpose. The parameter reference lists allowed options and form bounds. These are UI constraints, not guarantees of broker support. The broker master, fresh data and server validation remain authoritative.

sections.title: Sector rotation and stock cards
text: Sector rotation ranks available sector observations using the selected mode, score components, relative strength, momentum, breadth, volume and timeframe alignment. Filter narrows the visible set; Sort changes ranking. Missing observations are disclosed rather than treated as zero.

Open a sector or stock card to inspect contributors, indicator evidence and historical observations. A sector leader or historical BUY label is not an accepted order. Official constituent weights can be partial or dated. Stock-card broker-candle and rule-based analysis makes no OpenAI call.

sections.title: Analysis handoff · stock, index and commodity analysis
text: Select the broker account and instruments, planning preferences and analysis path. Broker candles and rule-based analysis uses no AI call. Codex / ChatGPT-account analysis uses the configured account workflow rather than an OpenAI API key. AI or broker data unavailability must remain visible; it does not establish a login failure by itself.

The index/commodity panel accepts one to six broker-native symbols. Eligible results can include the actual ATM option contract, premium entry, premium target, premium stop, lot size and reward/risk; missing or stale contract/quote evidence leaves the idea ineligible. Existing open exposure can exclude an instrument to avoid duplicate entries.

Analysis submissions run as background jobs. The page releases submission controls after acceptance, renders results when available, and retains completed or partial output for later retrieval. Stop targets the selected analysis job. Recommendations remain research until a separate explicit trading action passes current validation.

Planning capital, daily and per-idea limits, reserve, concurrent positions, reward/risk and declared external risk constrain planning when enabled. Fresh funds inclusion is optional. Exporting a packet or downloading settings does not send an order.

sections.title: Runner jobs and saved analysis outputs
text: Each submitted job/run has an independent identity. Active jobs are listed separately from optional stopped/saved history. Completed, failed, cancelled, running, pending reconciliation and stalled are different states; stalled/unresponsive requires heartbeat evidence.

Open a job to inspect its account, captured settings, chart link, status, trade journal and audit evidence. Entries and exits show recorded reasons, quantities, times, prices and P&L where supplied. Missing older evidence is unavailable, not fabricated. P&L refreshes independently of the background work.

Results persist across section changes, page reloads and navigation. Use saved jobs to retrieve them later. Stop is job-specific. Cancellation can preserve partial analysis output; stopping a trading runner follows its own position and pending-order policy, so verify terminal status and broker reconciliation.

sections.title: Renko Supertrend · setup, entries and exits
text: Select the instrument, Runner timeframe, Paper/Live mode, quantity, capital and trade limit in Trade setup. The launch timeframe mirrors the chart timeframe. One saved editable preset is retained per instrument in the saved-configuration library. Save settings updates it; autosave retains the working draft separately.

When Start finds different parameters, the popup lists saved versus form values. Use form parameters submits the edited values; Use saved configuration applies that record, including its shown execution mode; Cancel submits no Start. Batch Start resolves each instrument choice before submitting. An already running job keeps its captured settings.

Family masters govern their strategy and chart children. OFF disables the family while retaining subordinate choices for ON. Strategy selections affect entries/exits; Indicator/chart selections affect studies and historical replay. Independent enabled entry gates must satisfy their supported rules. A disabled control can mean the loaded runtime does not support it.

Completed-candle mode waits for verified host closes. Intrabar mode evaluates a provisional state using verified current-candle OHLC and fresh market evidence; a provisional signal may disappear. A signal before arming, reconnection or lock release is skipped rather than replayed as an old entry.

Renko/Supertrend uses ATR, factor and Auto/Manual brick settings. Manual reference brick stays fixed across live ticks and chart timeframes. Broker-verified session duration drives its reference policy; do not substitute assumed NSE/MCX/crypto hours. EMA, RSI, ADX, structure, zones, proximity and optional retest/manual-marker filters have separate settings below.

Enabled exit criteria can act independently. Absolute underlying target/stop values are PRICE LEVELS, not distances or option premium points. Optional trailing is application monitoring, not automatically an exchange-resting stop. Entry filters do not imply that all exit checks are disabled.

Quick-loss protection counts host intervals touched by actual entry/exit fills, including both endpoint candles. A qualifying quick losing exit locks new entries within the recorded position range; a fresh strict breakout releases it. The window is not a forced exit timer. Missing net-cost/exposure evidence can retain a protective review lock.

Stop Runner requests the strategy’s stop/reconciliation/owned-exit workflow. A Stop click or order acknowledgement does not establish a fill. Check pending orders and any residual position. A new configuration must not silently adopt unexplained broker exposure.

sections.title: Renko Engine · research and execution modes
text: Renko Engine is a separate strategy/replay workflow. Select its broker account, exact instrument, host timeframe, lots/contracts and maximum entries. Historical replay evaluates the selected history and engine parameters; its chart markers are simulated events.

Paper and Live engine runs require the selected broker’s supported runtime and fresh source data. Engine ATR/Supertrend, EMA, rule, direction, session and anchor settings are defined by the engine form; they are not automatically interchangeable with Renko Supertrend settings. Replay does not authorize promotion or start a Live runner.

sections.title: EMA Band, RSI / MA crossover and KAMA
text: EMA Band calculates its chosen EMA independently on candle High and Low. The supported completed-candle signal selects the current eligible ATM Call/Put; entry session and same-direction cooldown restrict entries. Its chart timeframe/history are display-only. Optional option-premium stop/target percentages supplement the supported indicator exits.

The RSI / MA crossover runner smooths RSI with the selected SMA or EMA. RSI length and RSI-MA length are distinct from price EMA periods. A future completed crossover can produce the supported bullish Call or bearish Put entry. Trade limit, lots, premium cap, daily budget and Paper capital apply to that run.

The crossover runner’s underlying hard target/stop settings have their own exit semantics; when either is configured, its displayed workflow suppresses the EMA exit. Its optional percentage/point step trail differs from Renko’s full-position trailing policy. Read the module’s active journal and settings before interpreting a shared label.

KAMA uses completed-close efficiency, adaptive fast/slow smoothing, breakout or reclaim, slope and cooldown rules. Choose quantity, invalidation and per-idea risk. WAIT remains WAIT when its signal is absent; account eligibility does not create an entry. Live requires the module’s supported broker/runtime gate.

sections.title: Delta India · tickets, options, futures and research
text: Read-only analysis, Paper, Live and research backtest workflows have different side effects. Select the exact listed contract or supported ATM option route, native quote currency, whole contracts, order type, limit premium and IOC/GTC terms. A perpetual signal instrument and an option execution contract are different instruments.

Bought-option mode buys a Call for bullish signals or a Put for bearish signals. The supported perpetual route uses long/short exposure and its own collateral policy. Native contract units, tick, expiry and multiplier come from the selected broker master; INR display follows the verified conversion policy.

Manual tickets and strategy runners are separate intents. Manual orders do not inherit a runner’s trail automatically. Stop behavior is module-specific: the legacy Delta runner can stop entries while leaving exposure; use its explicit close/reconciliation path and verify residuals. The Renko Stop flow has different behavior.

Research grids compare RSI/MA, ADX, momentum and squeeze variants with explicit fee, spread, slippage, funding, contracts and capital assumptions. Chronological holdout is separate from training. Backtest profit is not evidence of option fills or permission to promote a configuration.

sections.title: NIFTY / SENSEX long straddles
text: A long straddle buys both supported ATM Call and Put legs. Lots per leg, entry window, combined-premium stop and target belong to that straddle workflow, not to a one-leg Renko option runner.

Paired legs are not an atomic exchange transaction. Inspect each leg’s accepted, filled and remaining quantities. Process Stop is not proof of broker square-off; use the module’s explicit managed close flow and reconcile both legs. Paper and Live scripts/configurations must be identified in the displayed runtime evidence.

sections.title: Holdings review, live feed and positions
text: Holdings review selects a saved broker account, fetches that broker’s holdings and shows the available review categories. It is not a combined unlabelled portfolio. Missing permissions, session failures or unavailable holdings routes must be shown for that account.

Live feed & positions separates ticks, candles, order stream, positions, orders and fills. Fresh ticks do not prove the current candle has a verified open. Fresh receipt time does not prove a fresh exchange quote. An accepted order, a partial fill, a full fill and an unresolved submission are distinct.

Existing-position Renko adoption is a separate explicit live-management action. Eligible owned quantities and pending orders must be verified; adopting a filled position does not submit an initial buy. Pause monitoring can preserve exposure, unlike a stop-and-close action. Reconcile/resume does not invent missing historical fills or ticks.

sections.title: Screener, trade parser, Telegram and WhatsApp
text: Save a screener label and supported Chartink URL, evaluate candidates, then inspect account-native instruments and analysis. Cash product, quantity and external risk belong to the reviewed order flow. A screener row is not a submitted trade.

Paste or load recommendation text, parse it, inspect exact contract, side, quantity, entry/trigger/limit, stop and targets, then explicitly Submit. Edits invalidate stale tickets. Network uncertainty requires reconciliation rather than duplicate submission. An open position/order can block a redundant symbol entry.

Telegram channel label is only a display name. Bot access and exact channel identity are separate. Poll interval controls discovery; Auto submission is an explicit separate policy. Startup backlog and duplicate/edit evidence do not authorize replayed orders. Stop polling does not cancel already accepted broker orders.

The Telegram bought-option route can attach selected Renko exits after the reviewed mapping/quantity choice. XAUUSD-to-XAUT is an explicit proxy, not the same instrument. WhatsApp polling requires the native helper and exact chat; unavailable source/unread evidence blocks automatic ingestion.

sections.title: Charts, timeframe, viewport and freshness
text: Runner timeframe is the host interval for the next Start and is synchronized with the chart control. Timeframe changes on an active job require the explicit supported workflow; ordinary draft edits do not silently change its captured run. EMA Band has a separately labelled display-only chart interval.

Host candles use broker OHLC. Synthetic Renko bodies and historical entry/exit arrows are calculations. Actual trade markers use recorded order/fill evidence. Full screen changes layout; Reset view restores readable scale and recent bars. Deliberate historical scrolling should remain distinct from following latest.

History range, initialization anchor and warmup affect path-dependent replay. Missing or invalid OHLC can withhold indicators while valid candles remain displayed. Tick-live/candle-delayed means price observations exist but verified candle data is incomplete. Chart differs from active runner means compare instrument/timeframe/settings, not assume a login failure.

sections.title: Server resources, restart progress and recovery
text: Server resources shows resource samples and retained history. Admin restart controls for the dashboard and broker services are grouped here. Restart requests have independent identities and reported outcomes; a browser/network timeout does not establish restart failure.

The progress indicator shows Request, Restart, Readiness and Complete, with elapsed time and frequent probes. It does not invent an estimated percentage. READY requires the applicable readiness evidence. FAILED and UNKNOWN are explicit; do not automatically resend an uncertain restart request.

Before a restart, inspect active runners, retained positions and pending orders. A service can return while a retained strategy remains stopped. Never infer that exit monitoring resumed from a green page badge; check the specific job and broker state. Access controls and account isolation remain in force.

sections.title: P&L, journals, exports and troubleshooting
text: Gross P&L, estimated costs, estimated net and broker-reported values are separate. Fresh executable valuation and known fills are required; missing fees, funding or prices can leave net unknown. Zero must not replace unavailable evidence.

Job detail journals retain actual entry criteria, settings snapshot, requested/filled/remaining quantity, entry/exit prices and times, exit reasons and recorded P&L. Older missing evidence remains missing. Configuration TXT records settings; journal exports record execution evidence; neither export sends an order.

Start blocked: read the exact account, instrument, data, runtime or exposure reason. Feed delayed: distinguish tick freshness, candle verification and order connectivity. Stopping or UNKNOWN: reconcile the selected job and broker orders before another action. Some jobs unavailable: other jobs can still be running; a partial inventory is not proof of termination.

Expired session: renew the same saved account through its supported connection workflow, then test it. A slow analysis or market-data request alone does not prove login failure. Inspect Server resources and the affected job rather than repeatedly starting or submitting.
